## ansi: literals
{"t":"null"} => "NULL"
{"t":"default"} => "DEFAULT"
{"t":"bool","v":true} => "TRUE"
{"t":"bool","v":false} => "FALSE"
{"t":"int","v":-42} => "-42"
{"t":"bigInt","v":"9007199254740993"} => "9007199254740993"
{"t":"float","v":1.5} => "1.5"
{"t":"decimal","v":"123.4500"} => "123.4500"
{"t":"text","v":"it's"} => "'it''s'"
{"t":"text","v":"a\\b"} => "'a\\b'"
{"t":"text","v":"héllo\nworld"} => "'héllo\nworld'"
{"t":"bytes","v":{"base64":"AP9B","len":3,"truncated":false}} => "X'00ff41'"
{"t":"date","v":"2024-02-29"} => "'2024-02-29'"
{"t":"timestampTz","v":"2024-02-29 12:00:00+07"} => "'2024-02-29 12:00:00+07'"
{"t":"uuid","v":"6f1c2e2a-8a43-4c4e-9b1e-1f5f0c1d2e3f"} => "'6f1c2e2a-8a43-4c4e-9b1e-1f5f0c1d2e3f'"
{"t":"json","v":"{\"b\": \"it's\"}"} => "'{\"b\": \"it''s\"}'"
{"t":"array","v":[{"t":"int","v":1},{"t":"text","v":"x"}]} => "'{\"1\",\"x\"}'"
{"t":"other","v":{"ty":"hierarchyid","text":"/1/2/"}} => "'/1/2/'"

## tsql: literals
{"t":"null"} => "NULL"
{"t":"default"} => "DEFAULT"

{"t":"bool","v":false} => "0"

{"t":"bigInt","v":"9007199254740993"} => "9007199254740993"
{"t":"float","v":1.5} => "1.5"
{"t":"decimal","v":"123.4500"} => "123.4500"
{"t":"text","v":"it's"} => "N'it''s'"
{"t":"text","v":"a\\b"} => "N'a\\b'"
{"t":"text","v":"héllo\nworld"} => "N'héllo\nworld'"
{"t":"bytes","v":{"base64":"AP9B","len":3,"truncated":false}} => "0x00ff41"
{"t":"date","v":"2024-02-29"} => "N'2024-02-29'"

{"t":"uuid","v":"6f1c2e2a-8a43-4c4e-9b1e-1f5f0c1d2e3f"} => "N'6f1c2e2a-8a43-4c4e-9b1e-1f5f0c1d2e3f'"

## inline params
Dollar: "SELECT '$1' AS x, $1, $2::int, $3, $4 FROM t"
  => "SELECT '$1' AS x, 'a?b', 2::int, NULL, $4 FROM t"
Question: "SELECT '?', ?, ? /* ? */, ?, ? FROM t"
  => "SELECT '?', 'a?b', 2 /* ? */, NULL, ? FROM t"
QuestionNumbered: "SELECT ?1, ?2, ?1, \"?3\", ?3 FROM t"
  => "SELECT 'a?b', 2, 'a?b', \"?3\", NULL FROM t"
AtP: "SELECT @P1, @P2, @@ROWCOUNT, N'@P3', @P3 FROM t"
  => "SELECT 'a?b', 2, @@ROWCOUNT, N'@P3', NULL FROM t"
AtName: "SELECT @p1, @p2, \"@p3\", @p3 FROM t"
  => "SELECT 'a?b', 2, \"@p3\", NULL FROM t"
Colon: "SELECT :1, x::int, :2, ':3', :3 FROM t"
  => "SELECT 'a?b', x::int, 2, ':3', NULL FROM t"
Typed: "SELECT {p1:String}, {p2:Nullable(Int64)}, '{p3:String}', {p3:String} FROM t"
  => "SELECT 'a?b', 2, '{p3:String}', NULL FROM t"
